name.title: Platform Name
name.description: The name of this platform instance in HomeKit.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: List of switch devices. Each device appears as a separate accessory in HomeKit.

name.title: Device Name
name.description: Display name of this device in HomeKit.

switchBehavior.title: Switch Behavior Mode
switchBehavior.description: Controls how switches interact with each other within this device.

switchType.title: Switch Type
switchType.description: The HomeKit accessory type for all switches in this device.

masterSwitch.title: Master Switch
masterSwitch.description: Add a master switch that turns all switches on or off at once. Uses the same type as the device.

switches.title: Switches
switches.description: List of virtual switches in this device.

name.title: Switch Name
name.description: Display name of the switch in HomeKit.

defaultState.title: Default State
defaultState.description: Switch state on every Homebridge restart.

delayOff.title: Auto Turn Off (ms)
delayOff.description: Automatically turn off after this many milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable.
